items.title: ASML Sinks 6% in Chip Rout as Dutch Lawmaker Warns MATCH Act Is “Disastrous for ASML”
items.summary: Key TakeawaysASML fell 6% today, along with Applied Materials, Lam Research and KLA, as Dutch lawmakers warned against a US bill aimed at its China sales. The MATCH Act would push the Netherlands to tighten curbs on ASML’s immersion DUV tools or face US restrictions.
